description: This file defines a class that enforces the requirement for the 'type' attribute in <script> tags within the HTMLPurifier library. It ensures that scripts have the type 'text/javascript' if not already specified.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_ScriptRequired
classes.description: A class that ensures <script> tags have a 'type' attribute, defaulting to 'text/javascript' if not provided.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Adds or confirms the 'type' attribute in a <script> tag, defaulting it to 'text/javascript' if missing.
